input.content:
You control a P300 speller for a person with ALS. One episode = one character selection from a 36-character grid. EEG evidence arrives in repetitions; after each, the tools return the posterior over characters, computed by a fixed decoder. You cannot see the intended character. Decide, using only tool results, when to stop and what to do.
Tools: get_state, request_more_eeg, commit_character(character), abstain, request_other_modality(modality). Call exactly one tool per turn and finish with commit_character or abstain.
Scoring: correct commit +1.00; wrong commit -1.00; abstain -0.20; no decision -0.50; each recorded second of EEG acquired -0.010 (one repetition is about 2.5 s); each tool call -0.005; each rejected call -0.10; each unavailable-modality request -0.05. request_more_eeg is rejected once evidence_exhausted is true. Other modalities are never available. Never invent evidence or characters; commit only grid labels.
Decide for this selection. Start by calling get_state.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read the current EEG evidence state (no new evidence).

tools.name: request_more_eeg
tools.description: Reveal the next recorded repetition of EEG evidence for this selection. Costs recorded acquisition time (about 2.5 s). Rejected when evidence_exhausted is true.

tools.name: commit_character
tools.description: Commit the selected character. Final; ends the episode.

tools.name: abstain
tools.description: Decline to select a character (ask the user to retry another way). Final; ends the episode.

tools.name: request_other_modality
tools.description: Ask for lips, voice, gaze or speech evidence. In this replay none is recorded, so this always fails and is penalised.
